description: Simple SELECT queries with WHERE, ORDER BY, LIMIT

questions.question: Find the names and ages of all customers older than 30, sorted by age from highest to lowest.
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT name, age FROM customers WHERE age > 30 ORDER BY age DESC

questions.question: List all products in the 'Electronics' category, showing name and price, sorted by price from highest to lowest.
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics' ORDER BY price DESC

questions.question: How many orders have the status 'shipped'?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as shipped_count FROM orders WHERE status = 'shipped'

questions.question: What is the most expensive product? Show its name and price.
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Find all customers from Mumbai who signed up after January 1, 2024. Show their name and signup date, sorted by signup date.
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT name, signup_date FROM customers WHERE city = 'Mumbai' AND signup_date > '2024-01-01' ORDER BY signup_date
